title: Productivity God
tagline: Productivity AI buddy that keeps you accountable through financial DeFi incentives.
description:
Productivity God is your AI buddy that keeps you accountable through financial DeFi incentives.

Provide some liquidity to the Productivity God DeFi protocol, we then provide this liquidity to AAVE. Then, set some goals (daily, weekly, monthly). If you don’t reach them, part of your LP rewards will get slashed. If you reach them, earn some token rewards.

Your productivity-based AI agent is a game-theory financial system where users stake liquidity but face penalties on the rewards if they fail goals.
1. The AI sets and adjusts rules dynamically rather than static conditions.  
2. The AI personalizes penalties and rewards based on user behavior.  
3. The AI interacts autonomously with users, learning and evolving over time.  

Slashed rewards are aggregated by the DAO to be used to fund future development of the project or fund other initiatives decided by the community.
how_its_made: We used ElizaOS for the AI agent, we then used the Coinbase SDK to allow the agent to make on-chain transactions. We used solidity and foundry to develop the smart contracts for the protocol. We deployed on Base and Arbitrum. We used next.js for the frontend and Coinbase SDK for the wallet connection and blockchain interactions.
